data.name: Welcome
data.value: Good day. A few choices before I am at your service: my language, the microphone and the speakers, the models I need on this PC, and the language model that answers. Each choice is saved at once and can be changed later in the settings.

data.name: DoneText
data.value: Say “Hey Jarvis”, press the hotkey or click the orb, then ask your question.

data.name: DoneLater
data.value: Downloads still running go on in the background; the “Voice models” page of the settings shows them. This wizard opens again from the tray menu.

data.name: SaveFailed
data.value: The end of the wizard could not be saved: the settings file cannot be written. See the log for the cause.
